topic: Reports with joins, aggregates and CASE
title: The transcript report
instructions:
## The brief

The examinations office wants one report with a row per student who has **at least one mark**:

| column | meaning |
|---|---|
| name | the student's name |
| courses | number of enrolments **with a mark** |
| average | average mark, rounded to 1 decimal place |
| standing | `'Good'` if the average is 60 or more, otherwise `'At risk'` |

Sorted by average, highest first, then by name. Students with no marks at all do not appear.

The database has three tables: **students** (id, name, programme, level, hometown), **courses** (code, title, credits, lecturer) and **enrolments** (student_id, course_code, semester, mark). Marks can be NULL when a result is not yet in. Use the Tables panel to peek at the data.

## Do this

Join students to enrolments, ignore NULL marks (`WHERE mark IS NOT NULL`), group by student, and use `ROUND(AVG(mark), 1)` and a `CASE` expression for the standing. Column names must match: use `AS`.

config.schema:
CREATE TABLE students (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  programme TEXT NOT NULL,
  level INTEGER NOT NULL,
  hometown TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE courses (
  code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  credits INTEGER NOT NULL,
  lecturer TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE enrolments (
  student_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES students(id),
  course_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES courses(code),
  semester TEXT NOT NULL,
  mark INTEGER,
  PRIMARY KEY (student_id, course_code, semester)
);

initialState.sql:
SELECT s.name,
       COUNT(*) AS courses,
       ROUND(AVG(e.mark), 1) AS average,
       CASE ... END AS standing
FROM students s

hints: `JOIN enrolments e ON e.student_id = s.id WHERE e.mark IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.id, s.name`.
`CASE WHEN AVG(e.mark) >= 60 THEN 'Good' ELSE 'At risk' END AS standing`.

checks.label: The report has the right rows, columns and order
checks.expectedQuery: SELECT s.name, COUNT(*) AS courses, ROUND(AVG(e.mark), 1) AS average, CASE WHEN AVG(e.mark) >= 60 THEN 'Good' ELSE 'At risk' END AS standing FROM students s JOIN enrolments e ON e.student_id = s.id WHERE e.mark IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY average DESC, s.name

checks.label: It uses CASE for the standing
checks.message: Compute the standing with a CASE expression.

checks.label: It ignores missing marks
checks.message: Leave out enrolments whose mark IS NULL, or they distort the count.

realityNote: Real transcript rules weight by credits and handle resits; the shape of the query is the same, with a weighted average instead of AVG.
